option_relations.rationale: IgG4-related rhinosinusitis with concurrent Streptococcus constellatus bacterial rhinosinusitis is a specific instance of IgG4-Related Disease with Orbital Involvement
IgG4-related disease is a broader class containing IgG4-Related Disease with Orbital Involvement
IgG4-Related Disease (IgG4-RD) with Orbital/Sinus Involvement is equivalent to IgG4-Related Disease with Orbital Involvement
Invasive bacterial rhinosinusitis with orbital apex syndrome is not directly related to IgG4-Related Disease with Orbital Involvement

decisions.rationale: Invasive bacterial rhinosinusitis with orbital apex syndrome is not directly related to IgG4-Related Disease with Orbital Involvement
